meta.title: Travel Planner
meta.description: Plan trips with saved travel groups, trip purposes and home airports.

home.title: Travel Planner
home.tagline: Say once who you travel with and what the trip is about – every next trip builds on it.

errors.unknown_airport: At least one airport is unknown.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

login.title: Sign in
login.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
login.inviteOnly: Access is currently by invitation only.
login.linkInvalid: The sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
login.sentBody: If this address is invited, we have sent you a sign-in link and a 6-digit code.
login.codeHint: An alternative to the link, for example in the installed app.
login.codeInvalid: The code is invalid or has expired.

groups.title: Travel groups
groups.intro: Who is travelling? Everything here is optional.
groups.entryCount: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}}
groups.name: Group name
groups.notesHint: Free text, for example preferences or special needs of the group.
groups.entriesHint: Mix quick entries (for example 5 adults, about 45) and named people as you like.
groups.selfNoBirthdate: Your birthdate is missing in settings, so your age stays unknown.
groups.deleteBody: The group “{name}” will be deleted permanently.

entry.selfHint: Name and birthdate come from your settings.
entry.name: Name
entry.label: Label
entry.labelHint: For example parents, toddler or golfer.
entry.ageIgnored: The age is calculated from the birthdate.

purposes.title: Trip purposes
purposes.intro: What is the trip about? Write it freely or use the guided fields.
purposes.name: Name
purposes.textHint: Free text, for example “Golf with a friend, good food in the evening”.
purposes.guidedHint: Everything here is optional and complements the free text.
purposes.constraintsHint: For example “no flights before 9 am” or “at most 3 hours of driving”.
purposes.deleteBody: The trip purpose “{name}” will be deleted permanently.

settings.title: Settings
settings.birthdateHint: Optional. Used for your age in travel groups.

airports.label: Home airports
airports.hint: Search by name, city or code. Up to {max}, the first is preferred.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Your account and all your data will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
delete.dialogBody: All travel groups, trip purposes and settings will be lost.
